pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark brown patches with jagged edge gradients. Patches on the upper shoulder are larger and more contiguous, while flank patches show increased spatial separation and decreased relative area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Off-white inter-patch pathways forming a continuous topological web. Junction nodes vary from tri-radial to quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is widest at the neck-base and narrows towards the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette formed by a short, stiff mane extending from the upper neck across the shoulder hump.
